paragraphs: Rav Yehudah son of Rav Yehoshua.

Avodah Zarah 43b mentions him saying: “I heard it in Rabbi Yehoshua’s lecture.” Hyman calls this a printing error and proposes following the Rif and Rosh: “Rav Huna son of Rav Yehoshua said: I heard it in Abaye’s lecture: ‘Do not make with Me’—do not make Me.” Hyman says that the reading is likewise found on 42b there. Rosh Hashanah 24b attributes the teaching to Rav Huna son of Rav Idi; Hyman proposes Rav Huna son of Rav Yehoshua, reporting that reading from Dikdukei Soferim there.

notes.text: Hyman’s correction is to Rav Huna son of Rav Yehoshua, not Rav Yehudah. The checked texts retain Yehudah in Avodah Zarah 43b and Huna son of Idi in Rosh Hashanah 24b; his proposed harmonization is not silently imposed on those texts.
